description: This file contains a utility function 'formatLabel' that converts snake_case or underscored keys into human-friendly display labels in Title Case, with special handling for common acronyms. The function is intended for formatting JSON keys for display purposes in a web application.

methods.name: formatLabel(key)
methods.description: Converts an underscored or snake_case string into a human-readable Title Case label, handling common acronyms appropriately.
